title: Dynamic Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance via Online Feedback
property: prompt alignment, visual quality, human preference, text rendering, counting
reads: Noisy diffusion latent plus timestep through a latent CLIP ViT-B (256 tokens on LDM); four of five evaluators also read the prompt, visual quality does not.
trained_on: Alignment: WebLI noisy latents, contrastive, 90k steps. Others fine-tuned about 10k steps on real/generated COCO, human preferences, OCR scores, or 100K count-recaptioned pairs.
gradient_enters: No evaluator gradient in the proposed method: at each step the combined score selects the CFG scale by arg max (LDM scales 1, 3, 7.5, 11, 15).
unseen: no: evaluators are scored on prompt benchmarks with no category withheld from training.
headline: On Imagen 3, alignment + reward won 53.6% (Gecko) and 53.8% (GenAI-Bench) of human comparisons against default; on LDM 2B, Gecko score 47.2 against 43.8 and FID 24.8 against 25.6 for default CFG.
copy_or_avoid: Copy the seed-filtering test of early signal; avoid assuming summed gradients help, since CLIP + discriminator gradients scored 45.3 Gecko against 46.1 for CLIP alone (inferred).
model: LDM (Stable Diffusion variant, 865M and 2B parameters), Imagen 3
